description: You are a senior software architect at a growing e-commerce startup. The engineering team has flagged the ecommerce-monolith project as unmaintainable — all models, repositories, and services live in a single Maven module. Your task is to import the monolith project from /home/ga/ecommerce-monolith into Eclipse, then create a new multi-module Maven project at /home/ga/ecommerce-refactored with exactly three child modules: ecommerce-api (containing all model/domain classes), ecommerce-persistence (containing all repository classes, which depends on ecommerce-api), and ecommerce-service (containing all service classes, which depends on both ecommerce-api and ecommerce-persistence). The parent POM must list all three modules. Each module must have its own pom.xml with the correct groupId com.example and version 1.0-SNAPSHOT. Move all source files to the appropriate module while preserving package structure (com.example.ecommerce.*). The project must build successfully with 'mvn clean install' run from the parent directory /home/ga/ecommerce-refactored.
